opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities in the UK, with at least a ‘Good’ regulator rating where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new build, refurbishment and equipment projects that help people with disability live more independently, focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities in the UK, with at least a ‘Good’ regulator rating where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that improve mental health services, especially training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities in the UK, with at least a ‘Good’ regulator rating where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new build, refurbishment and equipment projects that support older people, especially those with neuro‑degenerative conditions or isolation.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities that manage listed historic sites (Grade I/II* etc.) and are open to the public for most of the year.
opportunities.summary: Grants for conservation, restoration, interpretation and education spaces at historic buildings, monuments and landscapes of national significance.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK, with at least a ‘Good’ regulator rating where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment that improve care for patients and families in hospice and palliative settings.

opportunities.title: Funding for places of worship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Places of worship of historic/architectural significance; specific eligibility follows the route (National Churches Trust or historic‑buildings programme).
opportunities.summary: Funding for conservation and restoration of places of worship of outstanding historic and architectural significance, delivered via the National Churches Trust or the historic‑buildings programme.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities that run public libraries or archives in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that improve public access to library and archive services.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities that operate public museums or galleries in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that enhance public access, interpretation and conservation of collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities that run public performing‑arts venues or companies in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that improve audience access and the sustainability of performing‑arts organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities that deliver public science engagement activities in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that expand public access to science exhibitions, labs or learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: State‑funded secondary schools or sixth‑form colleges in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that improve learning environments for 11‑18‑year‑old students.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools & colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Special schools or colleges in the UK that serve students with additional needs.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that enhance provision for learners with special educational needs.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities & research institutions
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and research institutions (including research‑intensive charities) that are registered in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that support research infrastructure and teaching facilities.
